newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money firms slightly to 3.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: German call money firms slightly to 3.10 pct.

text.p: German call money on Friday tightened slightly to 3.08/12 percent from 3.05/10 percent in early dealings as banks' end-of-month minimum reserve requirements started to figure in dealings, traders said.
Easter holidays at towards the end of the month mean that banks effectively had to meet their average monthly reserve requirements earlier than usual, they added.

"There's unlikely to be much fresh money in the market before Wednesday and then it will be a bit too late," said one. Bank reserve holdings with the central bank eased to 40.8 billion marks on Thursday from 43.2 billin on Wednesday.
The monthly average remained at 40.8 billion marks.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average was calculated at 3.12400 on Friday after 3.10625 on Thursday.
